name: @measnalazi/design-ss
description: Design App Store and Play Store screenshot strips as HTML, render them to store-size PNGs, and drive it all from one CLI.
author: Measna

scripts.test: npm run test:cli && npm run test:composer
scripts.test:cli: node cli/test/auth-hint.test.mjs && node cli/test/retarget.test.mjs && node cli/test/needs-input.test.mjs && node cli/test/editor.test.mjs
scripts.test:composer: node composer/test/screen-geometry.test.mjs && node composer/test/inspect.test.mjs && node composer/test/check-schema.test.mjs && node composer/test/pick-frame.test.mjs && node composer/test/render-server.test.mjs
